abstract: Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma has an extremely poor prognosis. Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma harbors a multidomain intratumoral microbial community dominated by bacteria and also containing fungi; its composition differs fundamentally from that of normal pancreatic tissue and drives malignant progression through three major axes: inflammatory-immune signaling, metabolic-epigenetic regulation, and stromal remodeling. Gammaproteobacterial lipopolysaccharide establishes a chronic proinflammatory microenvironment through the Toll-like receptor 4-nuclear factor kappa B axis, whereas in situ gemcitabine inactivation by the long isoform of bacterial cytidine deaminase represents the best-supported microbiome-mediated mechanism of drug resistance to date. In experimental systems, Fusobacterium nucleatum has been linked to tumor-cell invasion and alternatively activated macrophage polarization. In mouse and cell models, intratumoral fungi have been implicated in immunosuppressive signaling through the C-type lectin receptor dectin-1-interleukin 33 axis and the mannose-binding lectin-complement pathway; their relevance to human pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma remains debated. These three axes may converge on stromal activation and epithelial-mesenchymal transition and contribute to invasion and treatment resistance. Antimicrobial strategies targeting drug-resistance-associated bacteria can restore gemcitabine efficacy in animal experiments and have been explored experimentally alongside programmed cell death protein 1 blockade; the clinically appropriate patient populations and optimal sequencing of such combinations remain to be defined in prospective trials.
key_points_ko: 종양 내 감마프로테오박테리아(Gammaproteobacteria)가 분비하는 효소는 젬시타빈(gemcitabine)을 직접 불활성화하여 항암제 내성을 유발합니다.
푸소박테리움 눅레아툼(Fusobacterium nucleatum) 및 진균류는 암세포 침윤과 면역억제성 미세환경 조성을 촉진합니다.
동물실험에서 항균 전략을 통해 젬시타빈 효능을 회복시켰으며 PD-1 억제제와의 병용 가능성이 탐색되고 있습니다.
summary_ko: 본 논문은 췌장관선암(PDAC) 조직 내에 존재하는 마이크로바이옴(미생물무리)이 암의 진행과 치료 저항성에 미치는 분자적 기전을 검토한 종합 연구입니다. 종양 내 세균과 진균은 염증·면역 신호전달, 대사·후성유전 조절, 기질 리모델링을 통해 암 세포의 악성화를 촉진합니다. 특히 감마프로테오박테리아(Gammaproteobacteria) 효소에 의한 젬시타빈(gemcitabine) 불활성화는 대표적인 내성 기전으로 밝혀졌습니다. 항균 치료를 통해 항암제 반응성을 회복시키는 전략이 동물실험에서 확인되었으며 임상 적용을 위한 추가 연구가 진행 중입니다.
title: Molecular mechanisms by which the intratumoral microbiome drives pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma progression and therapeutic response
title_ko: 종양 내 마이크로바이옴이 췌장관선암의 진행 및 치료 반응을 유도하는 분자적 기전
